ValidationRule.description: Skill library (PLAN 72/76, 2026-10-20): an active record that is not Always Include or Proxy Injected is listed, so it needs a Library Description (spaces count as blank). Checked only on insert or when one of those 4 fields changes.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Active__c), ISCHANGED(Always_Include__c), ISCHANGED(Proxy_Injected_Instruction__c), ISCHANGED(Library_Description__c) ), Active__c, NOT(Always_Include__c), NOT(Proxy_Injected_Instruction__c), ISBLANK(TRIM(Library_Description__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Every active skill is listed in the Skill Library, so it needs a Library Description: two plain-English sentences on what it produces and what to give it.
